title: First Commonwealth Insurance Agency Acquires Established Ligonier Firm | First Commonwealth Bank
summary: First Commonwealth Insurance Agency Acquires Established Ligonier Firm
body_markdown:
First Commonwealth Insurance Agency Acquires Established Ligonier Firm


**INDIANA, PA (September 8, 2026)** ― First Commonwealth Financial Corp. subsidiary, First Commonwealth Insurance Agency (FCIA), has completed the acquisition of a Ligonier, Pa., agency that has been in business for nearly three decades.


**Anne Petrof**


**Lexie Petrof**


FCIA has acquired The Pennsylvania Insurance Specialists Inc., an agency operated by the mother-daughter team of Anne and Lexie Petrof, who have provided coverage in the areas of home, auto, life, business and more through a wide range of top-rated carriers for its customers in Pennsylvania and Ohio since 1998.


“We are thrilled to announce the acquisition of this firm that Anne and Lexie have nurtured and built for nearly three decades,” said Michael Bartolini, President of FCIA. “Anne and Lexie are wildly passionate about customer service and helping individuals, families, and businesses protect what matters most. We’re thrilled with the synergy and growth opportunities of our two teams coming together.


“We are in the process of notifying PA Insurance Specialists customers of the acquisition and look forward to continuing to service all their insurance needs, and hopefully, introduce them to the many other services First Commonwealth Insurance Agency and First Commonwealth Bank can offer,” Bartolini added.


The Petrofs both joined the FCIA team, effective Sept. 1. Anne will be a Consumer Insurance Advisor, and Lexie will serve as a Consumer Insurance Account Executive.


The Pennsylvania Insurance Specialists, Inc. and First Commonwealth Insurance Agency teams have a shared culture of high-touch customer care. They also share a commitment to the Westmoreland County community. Joining First Commonwealth Insurance Agency provides Pennsylvania Insurance Specialists, Inc. customers access to additional products, solutions, services and competitive rates and coverage.


**About First Commonwealth Financial Corporation**


First Commonwealth Financial Corporation (NYSE: FCF), headquartered in Indiana, Pennsylvania, is a community bank committed to its mission of improving the financial lives of its neighbors and their businesses. First Commonwealth operates 126 branches throughout Pennsylvania and Ohio and also has business banking centers in Pittsburgh and Harrisburg, Pennsylvania; and Cleveland, Canton, Cincinnati and Columbus, Ohio. First Commonwealth, through subsidiaries First Commonwealth Bank and First Commonwealth Insurance Agency, provides a full range of commercial and retail banking services, including mortgage, wealth management and insurance solutions, along with equipment financing and SBA and indirect lending. For more information about First Commonwealth, visitwww.fcbanking.com .
